pr.title: fix(factory): relax Bindings and Variables for `createMiddleware`

summary: This PR relaxes TypeScript type constraints in `createMiddleware` by introducing an `AddAnyToEnv` type helper that converts undefined `Bindings` or `Variables` to `any`. This allows nested middleware with different type signatures to compose without type errors. The change is purely type-level with no runtime behavior changes, and includes a test case validating the fix.
